<tool_call>
<function=python>
<parameter=code>

# Try clicking a cross to trigger reset
seg = current_frame.segmentation
N_nodes = [n for n in seg['nodes'] if n['color'] == 'N']
print(f"Crosses: {len(N_nodes)}")

if N_nodes:
    n = N_nodes[0]
    b = n['boundary']
    rows = [p[0] for p in b]
    cols = [p[1] for p in b]
    cr, cc = sum(rows)//len(rows), sum(cols)//len(cols)
    print(f"Clicking cross at ({cr}, {cc})")
    result = action([{'action': 'MOUSE', 'row': cr, 'col': cc}])
    
    seg = current_frame.segmentation
    colors = {}
    for n in seg['nodes']:
        c = n['color']
        colors[c] = colors.get(c, 0) + 1
    print(f"Colors after: {colors}")
    
    ascii_lines = current_frame.ascii.split('\n')
    bar = ascii_lines[0]
    print(f"Bar after: {bar}")
    print(f"Game over: {last_action_result.get('game_over')}")
    print(f"Level completed: {last_action_result.get('level_completed')}")
    
    # Check for purple
    p_nodes = [n for n in seg['nodes'] if n['color'] == 'p']
    print(f"Purple nodes: {len(p_nodes)}")
</parameter>
</function>
</tool_call>
